requirements.text: The system shall ensure compliance with data protection regulations while maintaining efficient performance.
The system shall provide transparency in attendance recording by logging all attendance changes with timestamps and user identification.
The system shall allow students to dispute attendance records through a formal process within 10 days of marking.
The system shall ensure that attendance reports generated include anonymized data to protect student identities.
The system shall include a feature to notify students of their attendance status within 24 hours of a class.
The system shall implement role-based access control to restrict attendance data access based on user roles.
The system shall maintain historical attendance data for at least five years for compliance and analysis.
The system shall ensure secure authentication of users to prevent unauthorized access to attendance data.
The system shall provide real-time data synchronization while prioritizing safety and energy efficiency.
The system shall implement automated alerts for discrepancies in attendance reporting to ensure data accuracy.
The system shall implement energy-efficient algorithms for real-time attendance updates.
The system shall generate attendance reports efficiently while ensuring student anonymity.
The system shall explore homomorphic encryption techniques to enhance data security without compromising performance.
The system shall include regular audits of security measures to ensure compliance with data protection regulations.
